$about: Direction pack. Turns brand and brief answers into a signed direction: opening, spine, colour field, one borrowed device, a refusal and a named cost.
title: Direction

context.question: Set the six dials for this direction.
context.help: Density, contrast, warmth, editoriality, ornament, motion — 0 to 5.
context.why: The dials are the difference between 'editorial' as an adjective and editorial as a measurable setting.

context.question: Is there a reference pack to borrow a device from?
context.help: A captured pack with device/avoid notes. Eagle alone does not count unless it has been captured into references/.
context.why: A direction needs one named device or a stated reason there is none; 'no references' must be a decision, not an omission.

context.question: Which single device are you borrowing, and what must not be copied?
context.help: Name the device, the reference it came from, and the surface that stays theirs.
context.why: Borrowing a device is research; copying a palette, wordmark or illustration style is imitation.

context.question: Which reference from outside the category is guiding this, or why is there none?
context.help: Print, film, packaging, architecture, a museum label. Name it and the device it teaches.
context.why: A shelf of competitor sites converges; the distance reference is what stops the direction becoming a category average.

context.question: What carries the first screen?
context.help: One thing leads: a statement, an index, an image, or the ledger itself.
context.why: The opening is the 10-second answer; everything below it is the second read.

context.question: What is the page spine?
context.help: The structural idea every page repeats.
context.why: A spine is what makes pages siblings rather than templates.

context.question: Where is the brand colour allowed to become a field?
context.help: One rule, applied everywhere: evidence surfaces, every sheet, or nowhere.
context.why: A field rule is a decision about where proof lives; leaving it implicit is how a brand colour ends up painted nowhere.

context.question: How do the display and reading roles differ?
context.help: Family, size jump, optical-size axis, measure.
context.why: Type contrast is the cheapest hierarchy device and the one most often replaced by decorative noise.

context.question: What is the one signature device?
context.help: The thing a reader would remember. One, capped.
context.why: One deliberate device reads as authored; three read as a theme.

context.question: What motion is permitted, and what happens under reduced motion?
context.help: Duration, curve, what moves, and the fallback.
context.why: Motion is part of the contract; a later 'small' animation is a reopened decision.

context.question: What does this direction refuse?
context.help: The things it deliberately does not do, even when they would work.
context.why: A refusal is the clearest statement of taste, and the easiest test for a later build.

context.question: What does it give up?
context.help: The good thing this direction trades away.
context.why: A direction without a cost is a wish; the cost is what makes it a decision.

context.question: Confirm the forbidden list.
context.help: Inherited from the brand; amend only with a reason.
context.why: The forbidden list is the guard against surface imitation and the defaults the category rewards.

context.question: Write the committed direction in one paragraph.
context.help: One direction, three decisions, one refusal, one cost.
context.why: This paragraph is the contract every later stage reads.
